messages:
yvonne: planning a conservative rollout for mercury-quant-11b:v2 in the 00:00-01:00 UTC change window. approach: laddered traffic 2% -> 10% -> 30% with 15m steady between steps.
marc: sounds good. let's protect regulated and enterprise selectors by pinning to mercury-quant-11b:v1 for first 1h. i'll apply a short TTL pin.
trent: fallback ordering proposal: 1) tenant pin (if present), 2) mercury-quant-11b:v1 (previous), 3) aurora-8b-quant (cheaper fallback). prefer falling back to previous stable before moving to cheaper models.
sre-ops: monitoring thresholds: immediate rollback if p95 > 1000ms OR error_rate > baseline*1.6 for 4m. page if p95 > 1400ms. also watch qps drop > 12% sustained for 3m. dashboard: https://console/redwood/dashboards/mercury-quant-canary
yvonne: deploy-bot, queue laddered enable and attach runbook tag mercury-rollout. include monitors p50,p95,errors,qps and semantic smoke set SMOKE_MERCURY_V2.
deploy-bot: queued: /run deploy catalog enable mercury-quant-11b:v2 --ladder=2,10,30 --step-duration=15m --window=2026-04-20T00:00Z-01:00Z --monitors=p50,p95,errors,qps --note="mercury laddered rollout"
marc: pin command applied: POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"(regulated|enterprise)","model":"mercury-quant-11b:v1","ttl":"1h"} verified.
trent: rollback runbook snippet for oncall:
```
# stop ladder (remove traffic for v2)
/run deploy catalog set-traffic --model=mercury-quant-11b:v2 --percent=0
# full rollback to v1
/run deploy catalog rollback --model=mercury-quant-11b:v2 --to=mercury-quant-11b:v1 --reason="latency/regression"
# pin old variant for 1h
POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"enterprise","model":"mercury-quant-11b:v1","ttl":"1h"}
```
marc: assigning oncall: @trent primary, @sre-ops backup for 01:00-03:00 UTC watch window. trent will run the ladder steps if green.
trent: i'll be on pager and will post metric snaps at each steady point. will abort early if any threshold breaches.
yvonne: preflight checklist: pins applied, smoke set pass, runbook linked, oncall ack. will push job at +6m.
sre-ops: initial smoke eval PASS. KV cache warming pre-step enabled to reduce cold p99 risk.
deploy-bot: starting ladder at 2% now. first metric snapshot at +6m.
sre-ops: +6m: p50=100ms p95=410ms errors=baseline. no alerts.
trent: moving to 10% after steady.
deploy-bot: scaling to 10% now.
sre-ops: +10m post-scale: p95=460ms errors flat. no page.
trent: proceeding to 30% after 15m steady.
yvonne: reminder: if any semantic regression on SMOKE_MERCURY_V2 (>1% hallucination delta) abort and rollback immediately.
trent: at 30% steady: p95=520ms errors within threshold, smoke eval shows 0.4% hallucination delta. all green.
marc: removing temporary pins in 40m unless any issue. i'll update changelog and notify #release-notes.
yvonne: thanks team, will hand off 24h watch to platform after window.
